extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern “DIRECT – GREAT Life II” is a Direct Purchase whole life plan designed to provide lifetime protection against Death, Terminal Illness and Total & Permanent Disability (TPD), while accumulating cash value over time. It is “easy to understand” and can be bought directly with no financial advisory cost (subject to direct purchase availability). Premium payment can be chosen up to age 70 next birthday or up to age 85 next birthday (document states all ages are age next birthday). The base TPD benefit is limited to a maximum TPD Benefit of S$5,000,000 across all policies and riders on the same life, and is only applicable if TPD occurs before the policy anniversary when the life assured is age 65 next birthday. There is also a Direct – Great Critical Care 70/85 rider option providing accelerated payouts for 30 critical illnesses, with an overall CI benefit cap of S$3,000,000.
quality_notes: Brochure content includes base product purpose and several key definitions/limits for Terminal Illness, TPD, and the critical illness rider.
No explicit numeric premium amount, cash value formula, surrender value details, or ward class/underwriting class are stated in the provided text.
Exclusions are only partially specified (e.g., rider waiting period/diagnosis limitation); full exclusion list is referenced but not provided.

policies.quick_summary: Direct Purchase whole life plan providing lifetime protection against Death, Terminal Illness, and Total & Permanent Disability, with premium payment choices up to age 70 or age 85 next birthday and cash value accumulation over time; TPD is capped and only applies if it occurs before the policy anniversary when the life assured reaches age 65 next birthday. A Critical Care rider may be attached (optional). Also subject to stated caps on TPD and sum assured for direct purchase whole life plans (S$200,000 limit). Openly notes a terminal illness definition and key rider limitation periods if the CI rider is attached.

important_caveats: This is a Direct Purchase Insurance plan that can be signed up directly without seeking advice from any financial advisory representative.
As buying a life insurance policy is a long-term commitment, early termination usually involves high costs and surrender value, if any, may be zero or less than total premiums paid.
TPD is only applicable if TPD occurs before the policy anniversary on which the life assured is age 65 next birthday.

benefits.benefit_description: Provides lifetime protection against Total and Permanent Disability (TPD), subject to definition requirements and a maximum TPD benefit limit across policies and riders.
benefits.trigger_description: Either (a) total inability to engage in any occupation/business/activity for income/remuneration/profit due to accident or sickness, continuing uninterrupted for at least 6 consecutive months, and deemed permanent with no possibility of improvement; OR (b) total and irrecoverable loss of use of specified senses/limbs as enumerated.
covered_conditions: Accident or sickness causing total inability for at least 6 consecutive months (option a)
Specified irrecoverable loss of use of sight/limbs (option b)
benefits.benefit_start_description: TPD must continue uninterrupted for at least 6 consecutive months from when disability started (definition requirement).
benefits.benefit_expiry_description: Only applicable if TPD occurs before the policy anniversary on which the life assured is age 65 next birthday.
benefits.notes: The document provides the TPD definition, a maximum TPD benefit of S$5,000,000 across all policies and riders on the same life assured, and a cutoff based on the policy anniversary at age 65 next birthday. The actual payout amount is not explicitly stated beyond the maximum.

evidence.quote: Total and Permanent Disability (TPD) refers to:

(a) The Life Assured, due to accident or sickness, is disabled to such an extent as to be rendered totally unable to engage in any occupation, business or activity for income, remuneration or profit; and the disability must continue uninterrupted for at least 6 consecutive months from the time when the disability started
Subject to a maximum TPD Beneﬁt of S$5,000,000 on all policies and riders issued by the Company on the same Life Assured.
The TPD beneﬁt is only applicable if TPD occurs before the policy anniversary on which the Life Assured is age 65 next birthday.

riders.name: DIRECT – GREAT Critical Care 70/85 Rider
riders.description: Optional non-participating critical illness rider that accelerates and pays out the rider’s accelerated benefit (equal to rider sum assured) in a one-off lump sum upon diagnosis of one of 30 critical illnesses (with specified carve-outs). After payment, the rider and its accelerated basic sum assured together with bonuses are terminated.
riders.eligibility: Attach DIRECT – GREAT Critical Care 70 to DIRECT – GREAT Life II 70 (pay premiums up to age 70 next birthday) or attach DIRECT – GREAT Critical Care 85 to DIRECT – GREAT Life II 85 (pay premiums up to age 85 next birthday).
riders.notes: CI benefit cap and specific limitation for Angioplasty and a 90-day diagnosis limitation for certain conditions are stated in the document.

evidence.quote: Enhance your coverage against 30 critical illnesses with the DIRECT -  GREAT Critical Care 70 or 85 rider .

On diagnosis of one of the 30 critical illnesses (except for Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment for Coronary Artery), the basic sum assured together with bonuses (if any) from the basic policy will be accelerated and paid in one lump sum. This rider will then be terminated.
The amount of accelerated basic sum assured equals to the sum assured of this rider.
Subject to a maximum CI Beneﬁt of S$3,000,000 on all policies and riders issued by the Company on the same Life Assured.
You can attach DIRECT –  GREAT Critical Care 70 to your whole life plan DIRECT – GREAT Life II 70.

exclusions.exclusion: No benefit payable under the DIRECT – GREAT Critical Care rider for specified conditions if diagnosis is made within 90 days of rider commencement or reinstatement.
exclusions.notes: Document lists conditions: Heart Attack of Specified Severity, Major Cancer, Coronary Artery By-pass Surgery or Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment for Coronary Artery. Limitation applies when diagnosis is made within 90 days from the date of commencement of this rider, or from the date of any reinstatement.

evidence.quote: No beneﬁt under this rider will be payable for Heart Attack of Speciﬁed Severity, Major Cancer, Coronary Artery By-pass Surgery or Angioplasty & Other Invasive Treatment for Coronary Artery if the diagnosis is made within 90 days from the date of commencement of this rider, or from the date of any reinstatement.
